fresh_leads.qualification_text: Developer Intern Pineville, Louisiana Come join our team at Crest Operations! With companies located across the United States, Crest Industries is committed to bringing together the best people and the right resources to meet today's challenges and deliver the innovations of tomorrow. With significant recent growth and company acquisitions, Crest more than ever is a catalyst for change, using a little grit and a lot of determination to drive a forward movement for our customers and our employees. We know how difficult it is to manage change and solve problems. Continuous improvement is hard work. Founded in 1958, we've seen our share of struggles. We've failed.
